name: Salesforce Skill Check
scope: Qualify repeated sf apex run test JSON exports against unique execution IDs, native test outcomes and skill/host provenance.

requirements.title: Task specification
requirements.acceptance_check: Success cannot be awarded solely by the evaluated agent’s self-report.
requirements.source_implementation: Define prerequisites, permitted tools, expected artifacts and prohibited effects independently of the tested skill.
requirements.source_prerequisites: Maintainer-approved tasks; M3; synthetic repository/org fixtures.
requirements.coverage: Versioned skill and host values required with sf test execution provenance.
requirements.blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.

requirements.title: Host adapters
requirements.acceptance_check: Adapter reports actual available capabilities and unsupported controls.
requirements.source_implementation: Run the same task through two selected coding hosts in isolated environments.
requirements.source_prerequisites: R01; host/API access; license/cost allowance; D6.
requirements.coverage: Distinct repeat execution IDs and nonempty native-shaped test arrays verified.
requirements.blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.

requirements.title: Outcome verification
requirements.acceptance_check: Nominal installation compatibility is distinguished from successful execution.
requirements.source_implementation: Check deployment, test results and supported record outcomes.
requirements.source_prerequisites: R02; D2 when live; reset fixtures; independent assertions.
requirements.coverage: Failed tests/summary outcomes reject qualification; missing metadata unknown.
requirements.blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.

requirements.title: Repeated comparisons
requirements.acceptance_check: Failures and uncertainty are included alongside successful runs.
requirements.source_implementation: Pin versions, repeat nondeterministic trials and track cost, false passes and variance.
requirements.source_prerequisites: R03; baseline skill/model versions; trial budget.
requirements.coverage: Real host adapters and provider/version drift evaluation pending.
requirements.blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.

requirements.title: Release gate
requirements.acceptance_check: A failing update can be held while the prior qualified version remains reproducible.
requirements.source_implementation: Generate versioned compatibility reports and configurable CI acceptance policies.
requirements.source_prerequisites: R04; external maintainer/owner criteria; CI runner.
requirements.coverage: Local CLI result supports regression consumption; public host qualification unproven.
requirements.blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.
